title: Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30-45k BRL

Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.

Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  1. Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  2. Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  3. System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  4. Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  5. Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  6. Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

title: Sr. Strategy Research Manager
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

About the Job

Senior Strategy Research Associate

Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Job Responsibilities：

1. Study the business segments, geographical layout, financial strength, and strategic play of the world's leading food delivery players, form a clear judgment on the global food delivery industry landscape and competitive situation, and propose effective development strategies and competitive strategies based on this judgment to support Keeta management's major decisions on resource allocation, organizational structure, capital operation, etc.

2. Participate in desk research, field research, and strategy formulation for Keeta's expansion into new countries, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation path of the company's strategic expansion into new regions, and combine facts and analysis to provide objective judgments on the industry, competition, and operational difficulties in specific countries to assist Keeta management in making decisions;

3. Understand the catering and food delivery industries, gain insight into the laws of industry development, keep close track of new opportunities and new models in related areas such as instant retail and catering SaaS, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation paths of new strategic directions to assist Keeta management in making decisions and assist in business implementation. Job Responsibilities:

4. Analyze the restaurant and food delivery industries, identify industry trends, and monitor emerging opportunities in related sectors such as quick commerce and restaurant SaaS. Explore and evaluate the feasibility of new strategic directions to support management in decision-making and business implementation.

Job Requirements：

  • Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in business-related majors such as business administration, finance, accounting, and economics;
  • At least three years of relevant experience in internet strategy analysis, strategic consulting, investment, and investment banking, with research experience in the catering, retail, and food delivery industries preferred;
  • Possess a keen business acumen, structured thinking skills, excellent oral and written communication skills, self-motivation and independent thinking, strong data analysis skills, and extensive project management and teamwork experience;
  • Working level English proficiency (C2).

Highlights：

- Contribute to the foundational growth of the Brazil business from inception.

- Join a core team within a key business unit, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the food delivery industry and enhancing commercial analysis capabilities.

- Work closely with senior decision-makers as part of a high-performing team.

Please upload both your English resume, thanks!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Infra/Deploy)
description:
About the Project

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.

About Role:

As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Solutions team spans the globe and uses the SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing.

Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. We are employing best-in-breed tools along with processes co-authored or directly influenced by our team. We believe in the power of great customer experience, and the happiest customers are made by having the happiest team helping them.

Work Hours : PST business hours.

Required skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience supporting a software platform/product in a customer-facing B2B environment.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems (Debian and RHEL-based), including package management, service management, log analysis, file permissions, user and process management, and troubleshooting system resources (CPU, memory, disk, I/O).
  • Basic networking knowledge, including OSI,DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, subnets, routing, and firewall concepts, with ability to troubleshoot using tools like ping, traceroute, curl, or netstat.
  • Understanding of containerisation (images, containers, networking, volumes) and virtualisation (VMs, hypervisors) concepts, and familiarity with orchestration concepts such as deployments, scaling, and service discovery.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Python or scripting languages such as Bash is a plus.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs is an advantage.
  • Experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is an advantage.

About you:

  • You have a data-driven, analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
  • You are detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines
  • You demonstrate a proven ability to stay motivated and work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • You bring a proactive passion for supporting and helping others
  • You have a strong desire to learn, grow, and contribute to the company’s core values of collaboration and service
  • You possess excellent English communication, listening, and writing skills
  • You possess a strong sense towards customer sentiment and adapt your communication style accordingly
  • You are clear in setting expectations and meeting the promised timeline

Scope of work:

  • You will handle customer questions and issues by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will perform troubleshooting of issues both through the UI and the terminal
  • You will work closely with Senior team members to develop your skills and technical expertise within specific areas of the product, with ongoing opportunities to grow
  • You will partner with Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Product to recognize trends in customer feedback and translate customer needs into a better overall product

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
• Responsible for plan, schedule and sequence the entry of materials into SSAB Brazil, in the different modes used;
  • Maintain constant and direct contact with internal teams and transporters to optimize vehicles and meet the dates scheduled by port agents, customers or industrializers;
  • Determine the schedule of the day, week and month so that logistics operators have the necessary information to receive, check, move and locate products according to scheduled loads;
  • Support the activities of the internal logistics operator regarding the organization and layout of storage areas and inventory control;
  • Act as a backup for load planning activities for the customers deliveries;

    • Responsibilities

    • Identify products received or scheduled to arrive, taking into account collection locations, available vehicles and deadlines for carrying out activities;
    • Make requests and monitor the availability of vehicles with transport companies;
    • Send, in accordance with SLA, reports on the movement of material for industrialization and monitor the return of empty containers.
    • Be aware of shipments in progress and scheduled for the following periods, making it possible to inform internal customers (IS and RSMs) of the status of receipts;
    • Have access to the electronic files necessary for better planning of material receipts, updating and/or ensuring adequate updating also by third parties.
    • Maintain direct and assertive communication with internal/external customers and others involved in the activities of transporting, receiving and sending documents;

    Required:

    • Degree in Administration, Logistics or Engineering;
    • Advanced English;
    • Experience in cargo planning and inbound/outbound logistics;
    • Advanced Excel;
    • Analytical sense and systemic vision;
    • Organization;
    • Good relationship;
    • Good communication;
    • Assessment of priorities supported by data;

    • ERP user (preferably SAP B1).

title: Líder Técnico de Digital Assets - Kaleido Brasil
description:
A função

A Kaleido está em busca de um Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil para nos representar como a face técnica do nosso negócio no país. Nesta posição sênior, você será responsável por conduzir ciclos complexos de pré-vendas, fortalecer o ecossistema de parceiros, impulsionar uma comunidade técnica vibrante e supervisionar as primeiras implementações de clientes. Você garantirá que os PoCs e as entregas iniciais em Kaleido/FireFly estabeleçam o padrão em segurança, conformidade e escala.

Sobre nós

A Kaleido oferece uma plataforma de próxima geração para construção e conexão com redes descentralizadas (ex.: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Canton) em nuvem e Kubernetes. Combinamos tecnologias open source e proprietárias para fornecer middleware, gestão de ativos digitais e soluções de custódia. Nossa plataforma permite que clientes criem casos de uso corporativos integrados a ecossistemas descentralizados e ativos digitais — seja em nosso SaaS ou em nuvens privadas.

Responsabilidades

Arquitetura de Soluções em Pré-Vendas

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery, delimitar escopos de soluções, realizar demonstrações, desenvolver PoCs e analisar RFPs; produzir propostas técnicas, estimativas e arquiteturas prontas para SOW.
  • Mapear requisitos regulatórios e de conformidade no Brasil (ex.: CVM 175, LGPD, controles do setor financeiro) para desenhos técnicos, boas práticas de segurança e runbooks.
  • Mitigar riscos em negociações com arquiteturas de referência, planos de migração e critérios de sucesso; acelerar a transição de PoC para produção.

Ecossistema de Parceiros e Alianças

  • Identificar, recrutar, integrar e capacitar parceiros.
  • Desenvolver programas de capacitação: currículo, laboratórios práticos, trilhas de certificação, ativos reutilizáveis (implementações de referência, blueprints Terraform/K8s, templates de contratos).
  • Conduzir iniciativas de co-sell e co-delivery com estratégias de GTM conjuntas e governança clara.

Comunidade Técnica e Evangelismo

  • Representar a Kaleido em meetups, conferências e universidades; liderar workshops, bootcamps e hackathons.
  • Publicar conteúdo técnico (blogs, tutoriais, apps de exemplo, arquiteturas de referência) e manter repositórios OSS demonstrando boas práticas de FireFly/EVM.
  • Formar uma rede de contribuidores e cultivar champions e maintainers locais.

Arquitetura e Acompanhamento das Primeiras Entregas

  • Orientar implementações referência em Kaleido/FireFly (EVM/Besu/Quorum), padrões de privacidade, troca de dados e integrações com sistemas bancários (APIs, eventos, ISO 20022).
  • Definir SLOs/SLIs, IaC (Terraform/Kubernetes), CI/CD, observabilidade e assegurar a transição suave para os times de entrega e sucesso do cliente.

Segurança e Padrões de Custódia

  • Projetar integrações seguras de gestão de chaves e custódia (HSM/KMS, MPC, cofres).
  • Aplicar modelagem de ameaças, auditoria e controles de privacidade em casos de uso regulados.

Feedback de Produto

  • Canalizar insights de mercado e parceiros para o roadmap global, defendendo padrões específicos do Brasil.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação/Engenharia (ou experiência equivalente).
  • 6+ anos em engenharia de software; 3+ anos em pré-vendas/soluções com clientes; 3+ anos em blockchain corporativo.
  • Experiência prática com EVM (Solidity, upgradeability, Hardhat/Foundry) e Kaleido/FireFly (ou frameworks similares de private-tx/data-exchange).
  • Conhecimento em padrões de integração com REST/gRPC, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, mensageria e ISO 20022; familiaridade com fluxos de liquidação (PIX/SPI/STR, DvP).
  • Cloud & DevOps: Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), AWS e/ou Azure.
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders (executivos, vendas, produto, reguladores).
  • Fluência em português e inglês avançado; espanhol é um diferencial.

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência no desenho de programas de capacitação de parceiros (trilhas de certificação, conteúdos, soluções conjuntas).
  • Conhecimento em Hyperledger Fabric e/ou R3 Corda.
  • Certificações de segurança ou nuvem (CISSP/CCSK, AWS/Azure, CKA/CKAD).
  • Experiência em palestras, publicação de conteúdo técnico ou contribuições ativas em OSS.

Diversidade e Inclusão

A Kaleido é comprometida em promover um ambiente inclusivo que celebre a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Valorizamos indivíduos de diferentes origens, culturas e experiências, e buscamos criar um espaço onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e apoiados. A Kaleido é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas qualificadas de todos os perfis a se candidatarem.

title: HSEQ Coordinator (Health, Safety, Environment, Quality - with Social & Environmental Focus)
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced HSEQ Coordinator with a strong background in environmental and social risk management to lead the implementation of the Integrated Management System (IMS) on a large-scale infrastructure project in Angola . This role will be instrumental in ensuring full compliance with international standards and in fostering a proactive culture of safety, environmental protection, quality, and social performance across all project phases.

This position is based in Angola and will contribute to the promotion of a proactive HSEQ culture aligned with international standards and best practices.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Integrated Management System (IMS) in alignment with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
  • Ensure full compliance with national legislation and international frameworks (IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles, and World Bank EHS Guidelines).
  • Oversee the application of environmental and social mitigation measures, including biodiversity management, stakeholder engagement, and grievance mechanisms.
  • Guide and mentor the HSEQ team, ensuring alignment with project goals, clear task allocation, and staff development.
  • Lead incident investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Coordinate stakeholder and community engagement in close collaboration with the social performance team.
  • Ensure quality assurance in construction activities through regular inspections, audits, and follow-up on non-conformities.
  • Deliver training and awareness sessions on HSEQ and ESG-related topics across all levels of the project team

Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Social Sciences, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in HSEQ roles with strong emphasis on environmental and social compliance, preferably in infrastructure or EPC projects.
  • Proven track record implementing IFC Performance Standards.
  • Strong knowledge of international IMS standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Demonstrated experience working in multi-stakeholder environments, including engagement with local communities and government entities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and analytical skills.
  • Experience working in African countries is considered an asset.
  • Languages : Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory. Spanish is considered an asset.

title: Analista De PCP
description:
Olá, somos a Urbem , e estamos empolgados para conhecer você!

Estamos falando de um canteiro de obras mais produtivo, previsível, sem geração de resíduos, mais rápido e seguro. Já pensou?

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão a partir de compromissos que impulsionam o desenvolvimento humano sustentável, a criatividade e a inovação. O que esperamos de você?

Estamos em busca de pessoas para serem protagonistas de uma nova dinâmica que conecta florestas a cidades. Que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes. Temos certeza de que uma de nossas oportunidades vai dar um “match” com você!

Nossa oportunidade para ANALISTA DE PCP (Planejamento e controle de produção)

Requisitos:

· Desejável vivência na área de PCP de indústria;

· Superior cursando/concluído Engenharia de Produção;

· Pacote Office com Excel em nível intermediário.

Confira abaixo as principais atividades da posição de Analista de PCP:

· Realizar o acompanhamento da produção;

· Planejamento da produção e de níveis de estoque com ferramentas e métodos aplicáveis considerando a demanda de vendas e informações do departamento comercial e engenharia.

E aí, vamos construir as cidades do futuro, juntos?

Vem ser URBEM.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Qualidade SR
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Qualidade SR para atuar no nosso time de SISTEMAS DA QUALIDADE.

Quais são as responsabilidades?

  • Gerenciar certificações, padrões do SGSA, cultura de qualidade, documentos e requisitos regulamentares;

  • Responder questionários de clientes;
  • Aplicar auditorias de BPF, Cultura de Qualidade e 5S;
  • Apoiar na abertura de não conformidades de fornecedores e prestadores de serviços.

Quais são os requisitos?

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia de Alimentos ou Engenharia Química;
  • Pacote Office em nível intermediário (Excel, Word e PowerPoint);
  • Certificação GMP+
  • Experiência com ferramentas da qualidade e metodologias de resolução de problemas (imprescindível);
  • Vivência com APPCC (Análise de Perigos e Pontos Críticos de Controle);
  • Conhecimento e experiência com certificações como FSSC 22000, Kosher e Halal;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de BI;
  • Conhecimento das legislações vigentes da área;
  • Experiência prévia em indústria.

Localidade:

Unidade Mandu/ Guaíra – SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Anotador de Dados
description:
Com mais de 18 anos de trajetória e mais de 100.000 equipamentos instalados no Brasil e América Latina, a Pumatronix é uma Indústria brasileira pioneira na fabricação de equipamentos de captura e processamento de imagens para sistemas de reconhecimento de placas de veículos (LPR) e o principal fornecedor para fiscalização de trânsito, concessionárias de rodovia e projetos de monitoramento e segurança pública no Brasil.

Nossa missão é transformar soluções de monitoramento inteligente de imagens em mais qualidade de vida para pessoas, contribuindo para o alcance de mais autonomia e liberdade para motoristas e pedestres brasileiros. Do desenvolvimento da tecnologia até a fabricação das soluções, tudo é pensado e executado internamente, através de equipes altamente engajadas a qual se desafiam diariamente com o objetivo de ser a melhor opção do poder público e da iniciativa privada quando o assunto é promover mais segurança e bem estar para a sociedade.

Nós, da Pumatronix, formamos o #Pumateam! Fazer parte do #Pumateam é se transformar a cada dia em sua melhor versão através da nossa Cultura Organizacional inspiradora.

O que nos torna especiais:

· Nos sentimos altamente recompensados em desenvolver tecnologias que resguardam vidas e promovem o bem-estar social;

· Nosso modo de ser se funde aos princípios éticos de transparência, honestidade, cidadania, respeito as pessoas e ao meio ambiente;

· A evolução da tecnologia e da sociedade nos obrigam repensar constantemente nossos processos, produtos e serviços de modo a torná-los melhores, mais simples, mais eficientes e mais baratos;

· Nossos ativos mais valiosos são o comprometimento de nossos colaboradores, a parceria de nossos fornecedores e a confiança de nossos clientes;

· Inúmeras oportunidades de crescimento sustentável se colocam diante de nós em uma sociedade que necessita de cada vez mais eficiência e qualidade de vida.

Para esta oportunidade, estamos buscando um profissional detalhista e focado para se juntar à nossa equipe de Inteligência Artificial como Anotador de Dados. O candidato selecionado será fundamental para o desenvolvimento de nossos algoritmos de visão computacional aplicados ao trânsito, trabalhando diretamente na rotulagem e classificação de datasets de imagens que treinam nossos modelos de machine learning.

Se identificou? Então confere os detalhes dessa posição incrível:

Como vai ser o seu dia a dia:

  • Identificar e delimitar com precisão veículos (carros, motos, caminhões, ônibus) em imagens e vídeos.
  • Marcar e identificar locais específicos, como placas de veículos, com exatidão de pixel.
  • Analisar os veículos identificados e classificar seus atributos de acordo com as diretrizes estabelecidas (ex: Marca, Modelo, Cor, Tipo de Veículo).
  • Revisar anotações existentes (próprias e de colegas) para corrigir erros, inconsistências e garantir a adesão estrita aos manuais de rotulagem.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de engenharia para reportar problemas nos dados (imagens de baixa qualidade, casos ambíguos) e sugerir melhorias nas diretrizes de anotação.
  • Assegurar que todas as anotações sejam consistentes ao longo de grandes volumes de dados, seguindo rigorosamente as regras do projeto.

O que esperamos de você:

Ensino Médio Completo.

Curso Técnico ou Profissionalizante na área de Informática.

Conhecimento e experiência no uso de computadores, incluindo navegação em sistemas de arquivos e uso de atalhos de teclado.

Habilidade para identificar e diferenciar visualmente diversas marcas, modelos e cores de veículos.

Desejável experiência prévia ou facilidade para aprender a usar ferramentas de anotação de imagem (como CVAT, LabelImg, V7 Darwin, ou ferramentas proprietárias).

Pacote office e ferramentas de gestão de tarefas.

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
SOBRE A LETS

A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com conhecimentos em vendas e na plataforma do HubSpot , apaixonada por resultados, métricas e empresas em pleno crescimento a LET'S é o seu lugar!

SOBRE A VAGA

Estamos em busca de um(a) SDR — Sales Development Representative para impulsionar a geração de demanda e criação de pipeline comercial em contas B2B (médio e enterprise). Você será responsável por prospecção outbound, qualificação de leads inbound, agendamento de reuniões qualificadas (SQLs) e pelo handoff fluido para o time de Vendas (AEs) .

No dia a dia, usará HubSpot (Sales/Marketing Hub) para rodar cadências multicanal (e-mail, ligação, WhatsApp/LinkedIn), segmentar listas, personalizar abordagens por ICP/persona e operar um processo data-driven com SLAs de resposta (lead response time) , taxas de conversão e show rate sob acompanhamento constante. Trabalhará em sintonia com Marketing (ABM, campanhas e conteúdo) e com Vendas (territórios, critérios de passagem, feedbacks de qualidade).

ATIVIDADES

  • Inbound: atender leads rapidamente ( SLA de minutos ), qualificar (BANT/CHAMP/MEDDICC-lite), registrar contexto e agendar reunião com AE.
  • Outbound: construir listas por ICP/persona, pesquisa de conta/decisores , rodar cadências no HubSpot (e-mail, call, WhatsApp/LinkedIn), personalizando mensagens e hipóteses de dor/valor.
  • ABM & personalização: trabalhar contas-alvo junto do Marketing (páginas ABM/Webflow, conteúdos e ofertas), adaptando pitch por segmento (varejo, last-mile, marketplaces B2B).
  • Qualificação & handoff: aplicar critérios claros de passagem (fit, timing, dor, potencial), registrar notas/objetivos próximos passos e garantir handoff sem fricção.
  • Métricas & rotina: controlar LRT, taxa de resposta, reuniões marcadas, show rate, SQLs , pipeline criado e conversões por etapa/canal; sugerir testes de assunto, templates e cadências.
  • CRM disciplina: manter HubSpot atualizado (propriedades, atividades, próximos passos), gerir tasks, listas e sequences com organização exemplar.
  • Feedback de mercado: coletar sinais (objeções, concorrentes, requisitos), produzir insights para Vendas, Marketing e Produto; fechar o loop com aprendizados.
  • Compliance & boas práticas: seguir políticas de opt-in/opt-out, LGPD , UTMs e qualidade de dados em todas as interações.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada (2+ anos) como SDR/BDR em SaaS B2B ou soluções complexas (ciclo consultivo).
  • Domínio de HubSpot (Sales Hub) no dia a dia (lists, sequences, tasks, deals, snippets, playbooks, relatórios básicos).
  • Prospecção outbound e qualificação inbound aplicando BANT ou CHAMP (ou equivalente) e perguntas consultivas (SPIN) ; cadências multicanal no HubSpot (e-mail, ligação, WhatsApp/LinkedIn) com disciplina de CRM.
  • Escrita clara e persuasiva (frio → quente), comunicação verbal confiante para ligações.
  • Organização e disciplina de CRM (registro de atividades, follow-ups, prazos).
  • Foco em metas (reuniões/SQLs/pipeline criado) e melhoria contínua via dados.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de materiais, e-mails e benchmarks.
  • Diferencial forte (não eliminatório): certificações HubSpot (Sales Software/Inbound) ou trilhas concluídas na HubSpot Academy/LinkedIn Learning.

HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS

  • Vivência em empesas de software (SaaS) ; logística/last-mile, varejo ou marketplaces B2B .
  • Experiência com LinkedIn Sales Navigator , ferramentas de prospecção (Apollo/Lusha/Hunter) e WhatsApp Business integrado ao HubSpot.
  • MEDDICC-lite/Challenger , ABM com mapeamento de decisores/buying committee, Sales Navigator , testes A/B de cadências/assuntos e co-criação de playbooks com AEs/Marketing.
  • Noções de ABM (contas-alvo, buying committee, mensagens por persona).
  • Integrações e automações com n8n ; familiaridade com Webflow ↔ HubSpot .
  • Espanhol básico é um plus.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados.
  • Comissão direta sobre as vendas.
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).

DETALHES:

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .
  • Como se destacar: envie links das certificações HubSpot , cases mensuráveis (ex.: ganho de conversão, redução de LRT, melhora de deliverability), prints/redashboards e uma breve descrição de arquiteturas de objetos/pipelines que você implementou e; faça os cursos dentro da HubSpot Academy ou no próprio LinkedIn comprovando seus conhecimentos.

title: Technical Project Manager - Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks
description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks with strong expertise in mobile and converged network architectures to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Nokia network solutions, virtualization technologies, and key signaling protocols, and will play a crucial role in aligning network strategies with customer and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support mobile networks (2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G) and fixed/converged network architectures.
  • Manage and optimize virtualized environments using Nokia CBIS VMs , containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms such as NCS.
  • Work with Nokia network elements and third-party systems including CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, and CSD .
  • Troubleshoot and optimize signaling protocols such as SIP, Diameter, and S7 .
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver network solutions aligned with customer and Nokia objectives.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and project risks effectively.
  • Provide deep analytical support and troubleshoot complex network issues.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile network technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), fixed and converged networks.
  • Experience with virtualization and container platforms ( Nokia CBIS , Docker , Kubernetes , NCS ).
  • Familiarity with Nokia network components ( CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, CSD ) and third-party solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, Diameter, and S7 protocols.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with customers and internal stakeholders to meet technical and business goals.
  • Excellent risk management, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting aptitude.
  • Proficiency in English.

P

referred Qualifications

  • Certifications or relevant education in Telecommunications, Networking, or related fields.
  • Prior experience working with Nokia systems and large-scale network deployments.

title: Coordenador de Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.

Principais Atribuições:

  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.
  • Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.
  • Acompanhar a legislação.
  • Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.
  • Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.
  • CRM (Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente) responsável por Incidentes/Reclamações Logísticas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em compras e gestão de suprimentos na área de logística.
  • Conhecimento técnico de processos logísticos, transporte e armazenagem.
  • Sólidas habilidades de negociação e gestão de contratos.
  • Experiência com compra/negociação de fretes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de apresentação e comunicação em espanhol e inglês.
  • Capacidade de influenciar e obter apoio em situações "de linha pontilhada".
  • Compreende as necessidades do negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Analista de Engenharia Pleno - Segurança Hídrica
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Apoiar na análise e desenvolvimento de estudos hidrológicos voltados à mitigação dos impactos de estiagens e secas;
  • Realizar o levantamento e monitoramento de indicadores de vazão, precipitação, volume de chuvas e comportamento de rios e barragens;
  • Avaliar e propor fontes alternativas de abastecimento, contribuindo para a elaboração de soluções técnicas e planos de investimento de capital (CAPEX);
  • Monitorar eventos climáticos e hidrológicos, analisando seus impactos sobre as operações da companhia e apoiando a tomada de decisão técnica;
  • Integrar e consolidar informações provenientes de dados de sensoriamento remoto, estudos climáticos, bases meteorológicas e análises de mercado especializadas, como as do Climatempo;
  • Manter comunicação ativa e constante com as frentes operacionais e áreas técnicas, garantindo agilidade e precisão nas ações preventivas e corretivas;
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico voltado à segurança hídrica, considerando cenários de estiagem, baixa vazão de rios e mudanças climáticas;
  • Garantir o registro e atualização de dados técnicos, assegurando rastreabilidade e consistência das informações analisadas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Ambiental, Sanitária, Hídrica, Civil;
  • Experiência ou estudos na área de recursos hídricos, hidrologia e segurança hídrica;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de geoprocessamento, incluindo ArcGIS e QGIS;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e tratamento de dados, como Microsoft Excel e Power BI;
  • Residir em Belém/PA ou região;

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at

Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.

Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.

Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Analista de Compliance Pleno
description:
Se você possui experiência com Compliance, PLD/AML, investigações internas e análise de riscos, essa área é pra você!

Aqui o foco é garantir conformidade, prevenir fraudes, monitorar transações suspeitas e investigar possíveis irregularidades. Tudo isso com alto impacto e responsabilidade!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

1. PLD/AML (Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento do Terrorismo)

• Monitoramento e análise de transações financeiras suspeitas.

• Implementação, revisão e manutenção de políticas e procedimentos de PLD/AML.

• Análise de perfis e comportamentos financeiros para identificar padrões de lavagem de dinheiro.

• Envio de comunicações obrigatórias para órgãos reguladores (ex: COAF no Brasil).

• Uso de ferramentas de busca de informações e procedimentos de due diligence para verificação de clientes e parceiros de negócios.

• Realização de treinamentos internos para conscientização sobre lavagem de dinheiro.

2. Background Check de Clientes e Fornecedores

• KYC (Know Your Customer): Avaliação de informações e histórico para verificação de identidade, entre outras informações, origem de recursos e reputação do cliente.

• KYS (Know Your Supplier): Análise de dados, impedimentos, avaliação da idoneidade e conformidade de fornecedores e terceiros.

• Consulta a listas restritivas e de sanções (OFAC, ONU, BACEN, entre outras).

• Investigação de conflitos de interesse e riscos de fraude.

• Avaliação de propriedade real (Beneficial Ownership) para identificar beneficiários finais de empresas.

3. Monitoramento e Investigações Internas

• Acompanhamento de indicadores de compliance e identificação de desvios de conduta, financeira entre outras não conformidades.

• Investigação de denúncias internas e análise de comportamentos suspeitos, identificando prováveis descumprimento de políticas internas.

• Atuar nas reclamações recebidas através do canal denúncias, averiguando a veracidade e as informações recebidas, sugerindo uma ação para adequação das regras éticas, convívio e de bom comportamento na empresa.

• Aplicação de auditorias e revisões periódicas nos processos internos.

4. Relatórios e Comunicação com Órgãos Reguladores

• Elaboração de relatórios ou apresentações periódicas para utilização interna ou externa da empresa, apresentando os apontamentos recebidos, bem como o plano de ação adotado.

• Comunicação de operações suspeitas para entidades reguladoras.

• Manutenção de registros e documentação de compliance.

5. Atualização Regulatória e Treinamentos

• Acompanhamento das emissões e/ou mudanças nas novas regulamentações na legislação, avaliando e definindo junto as áreas envolvidas o cumprimento e as ações necessárias para manter a empresa compliance com as regulamentações.

• Treinamento contínuo de funcionários para garantir a conformidade.

• Desenvolvimento e atualização dos manuais de compliance, acompanhamento dos vencimentos das políticas, atuando junto as áreas para garantir a conformidade e adequação as regras definidas.

• Apoiar na execução dos trabalhos planejados, emitindo diagnósticos, avaliando a eficiência e eficácia do ambiente de controles dos processos auditados.

Requisitos e qualificações:

• Formação superior completa Administração de Empresas, Economia, ou cursos correlatos.

• Experiência com monitoramento e análise de transações financeiras suspeitas

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:

In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product

  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)

  • Strong experience with responsive design frameworks (React Material, Bootstrap, Tailwind).

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: 

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed. 

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school. 

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer with strong Azure and DevOps experience to design, deploy, and support data infrastructure for our retail applications. The ideal candidate will combine data engineering skills with cloud automation and DevOps practices to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability in Azure.

This role is hybrid based in Sao Paulo on a contractual-basis, full-time hours, projected to be a year long, and for a global IT consulting firm.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain data and cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure.
  • Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines for data and application deployments.
  • Support SQL databases and BI tools (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
  • Automate cloud provisioning using Terraform, ARM templates, and scripting (Python, PowerShell).
  • Manage and monitor resources in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and other Azure services.
  • Implement and maintain alerting and monitoring (Azure Monitor, Grafana).
  • Ensure security, performance, and cost optimization of cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with developers and business teams to align DevOps and data practices with business needs.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 8–10+ years of IT experience with strong Azure Cloud and DevOps background.
  • Hands-on experience with AKS , VMs, networking, and Azure databases.
  • Strong SQL and data integration experience (SSIS/SSRS/SSAS) OR similar BI reporting tools .
  • Proficiency in Python and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with Terraform , Azure DevOps , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Knowledge of containerization ( Docker/Kubernetes ) and infrastructure automation.
  • Familiar with cloud security and disaster recovery practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or Azure Solutions Architect.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) is a plus.
  • Experience in the retail energy (power & gas) industry is an advantage.

If this job description aligns with you - or someone who you know is qualified - please attach your most updated CV/resume in English with a good phone number to reach you at . You can also email it to my colleague, . He will send you a call and give you the details in-length!

Brian Scott

title: Apparel Designer
description:
Job Title: Apparel Designer

Permanent Remote | Part-time

Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.

We’re partnered with a growing infant clothing and accessories brand that’s looking for an experienced and highly creative Apparel Designer to join their team remotely! This role is ideal for someone who can take a founder’s or creative director’s vision and translate it into production-ready designs that are safe, comfortable, and true to the brand’s aesthetic. If you thrive in both concept development and technical garment execution, this is the opportunity for you.

This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate closely with the brand’s founder and creative team to interpret design concepts and ideas into cohesive, marketable infantwear collections
  • Develop sketches, mood boards, and detailed tech packs ready for manufacturing
  • Select fabrics, trims, and color palettes that bring each collection to life while ensuring comfort, softness, and safety for babies
  • Oversee design revisions to ensure feasibility for production without compromising aesthetic quality
  • Research and apply emerging trends, silhouettes, and materials relevant to infant apparel and accessories
  • Communicate with pattern makers and production partners to confirm design accuracy and ensure seamless execution
  • Maintain organized digital design files and version control throughout the design cycle

What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Bilingual Spanish candidates preferred!)
  • More than 5 years of experience in apparel design, with previous work in infantwear or children’s clothing a strong plus
  • A portfolio that shows your range: sketches, flats, mood boards, and final garments (infantwear samples preferred)
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making (basic knowledge is a plus), and fabrics appropriate for infant clothing
  • Available to work US business hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer

Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - USD 1,000 per month , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a part-time role requiring a 20-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.

Additional Benefits

If the role transitions to full-time, you’ll gain access to additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, and eligibility to our Elite VA Program—plus ongoing career support from the StaffRight team.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:

We process animal by-products from slaughterhouses into high-quality food materials and raw materials for the pharmaceutical industry. Our products are 100% natural and, due to the knowledge and skills of our employees, of a very high and consistent quality. We strive to outdo ourselves every day.

About the role

Manage and coordinate the company's human resources function across subfunctions, such as recruitment, training and talent development, compensation and benefits, organization development, and employee relations, to meet company’s business requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the formation of one or more elements of functional strategy through specialist expertise and insights, to ensure that the strategy meets business needs.
  • Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and evaluate their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.
  • Deliver complex analyses of HR data; identify key trends and contribute to the creation of HR insights that enable the diagnosis of business issues, enhancement of employee engagement, and/or improvement of business performance.
  • Implement HR frameworks and tools for recruitment, performance management, development, career and succession planning, compensation and benefits, diversity, employee onboarding and offboarding, and retention of talent, within an area of expertise, to meet business or institution needs and enable the attraction, development, and retention of talent at a sustainable cost. Ensure compliance with specified design principles, internal policies, and external legal requirements.
  • Provide specialist advice on the interpretation and application of policies and procedures, resolving queries and issues and referring very complex or contentious issues to others.
  • Communicate the local action plan; explain how this relates to the function's strategy and action plan and to the broader organization's mission and vision; motivate people to achieve local business goals.
  • Help develop procedures for an area of the organization and monitor their implementation.
  • Deliver a budget for an area of the organization or conduct complex analyses on budget progress in other areas of the organization.
  • Contribute to the development and testing of HR data collection forms or questionnaires in a specific area of expertise to ensure the collection of relevant data in line with defined requirements.
  • Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.
  • Develop and propose own performance objectives; take appropriate actions to ensure achievement of agreed objectives, using the organization's performance management systems to improve personal performance. Or manage and report on team performance; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold people accountable for achieving them, taking appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
  • Manage workstreams or small projects within a transformational change program, ensuring integration with related projects; use structured change management methodologies to build acceptance of change and embed desired culture and behaviours.

About you

  • Further/higher education in human resources or business discipline, with 5-8 years prior experience in HR role.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to exercise good judgement
  • A team player with a professional and flexible approach to work.
  • Innovative thinking with a passion to make a difference within the HR team and wider business.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese and Spanish is essential for this role.
  • A solid understanding of current employment law and HR best practice.
  • Flexible with travelling between our four sites (Paraguay, Brazil, Argentina and Chile) is required.

Location Requirement

You must live within commutable distance of our Barreiros, São José - SC, , Brazil office as weekly onsite presence is required.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN

About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.

Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

Você separa e combina tarefas em fluxos de trabalho eficientes e simples. Você é decisivo(a) e toma decisões de alta qualidade, mesmo com informações incompletas ou diante da incerteza. Você demonstra uma enorme iniciativa em situações difíceis e é excepcional em identificar e aproveitar oportunidades.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Experiência: mínimo de 10 anos em gerenciamento de projetos de automação de média a grande complexidade;
  • Formação: Engenharia Mecatrônica, Elétrica;

Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.
